answer: Graph-sliced trust stops Sybils in four steps. First, a newcomer enters only through a staked edge from an established agent, each edge locking $20. Second, its score is the shortest staked path to a root agent; fake clusters score near zero. Third, peers audit one edge in seven monthly; a fake edge burns both stakes and bans the key 90 days. Fourth, limits grow only as the graph deepens. Faking 1,000 agents needs 1,000 edges and $20,000 plus sponsor bribes, all lost when caught. Like yarrow roots sharing one soil, a raven above sees every path: one honest road climbs out of the nadir.
